description: Bounded mutations for wall ordering, infill combination, and bridge setting behavior.

mutants.description: Disables the alternating extra loop; the enabled odd-layer perimeter count contract should fail.
Removes the setting gate so the disabled baseline would incorrectly combine sparse layers.
Discards the configured combined-infill height cap; positive sparse path heights must stay below 0.2, 0.4, or 0.6 mm as configured.

mutants.old: const bool is_thick_bridge = surface.is_bridge() && (surface.is_internal_bridge() ? object_config.thick_internal_bridges : object_config.thick_bridges);
mutants.description: Forces normal bridge flow for internal bridges; the thick toggle must change deposited bridge volume.
Drops the explicit internal bridge angle override; the 30 and 120 degree partitions require their requested bridge direction.
Disables overhang perimeter classification; the overhang fixture must expose erOverhangPerimeter only when enabled.
Removes the outer-first wall ordering branch; the outer wall/inner wall case must differ from the baseline and match a fresh slice.
Drops the configured external bridge density; the 50 versus 100 percent fixture must change deposited bridge volume.
Drops the configured external bridge flow ratio; the 0.5 versus 1.0 fixture must change deposited bridge volume.
Drops the configured internal bridge density; the 25 versus 100 percent bridge-volume partition should collapse.
Drops the configured bridge width from bridging-flow selection; the 0.25 versus 0.35 mm external bridge-volume contract should fail.
